name: tidepools-mcp

tools.name: get_journal_entries
tools.description: Retrieve Tidepools journal entries by date range.

endDate.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Retrieve a Tidepools page by exact title.

tools.name: edit_page
tools.description:
Apply revision-checked 1-based line edits to a non-journal page. Tidepools pages use a markdown-like format:
- Todos are markdown bullet points whose text starts with one of these statuses: TODO, DOING, NOW, LATER, DONE, WAITING. Examples: "- NOW write docs", "- LATER call mom", "- DONE make a cake".
- Formulas are bullet points whose text starts with "=". Example: "- =ask("question")". Preserve formula lines unless the user explicitly asks to edit them.
- Wiki links use [[Page Title]] syntax. Preserve this syntax when referencing or editing links.
- When editing existing content, keep replacementText as raw Tidepools markdown only. Do not include line-number prefixes such as "12: ".
- Prefer minimal line-based edits and preserve surrounding indentation, bullets, todo status labels, formulas, and links unless the requested change requires modifying them.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: BM25 search across Tidepools pages and journal entries.

tools.name: search_todos
tools.description: Search Tidepools todos by text and/or status.

tools.name: create_todo
tools.description: Append a new todo to today's Tidepools journal entry. Todo text should not include the leading "- STATUS"; provide text separately from the optional status.

tools.name: edit_todo
tools.description: Edit a todo returned by search_todos using its stale-safe todoId. Todo text should not include the leading status label; provide text separately from the optional status.
